To satisfy EECE500, you must complete ten weeks of approved internship: either ten weeks at one company or six weeks at one company plus four weeks at another company, with both companies requiring the applicable forms and employer documentation. Alternatively, you can do a combined arrangement such as a six-week internship plus a two-week research component, which must be approved and documented.

SOURCES: [email-clarifications.md > Taking another summer course (ECE)], [email-clarifications.md > Combined internship arrangements (ECE)]
